legislation.bill: A.9111C / S.8512C (Solar Up Now NY Act, promoted as the SUNNY Act)
legislation.cert_required: Accredited testing laboratory (e.g. UL); state fire code compliance
legislation.notes: A9111C / S8512C. The bill limits a device to 'supplying a maximum aggregate continuous AC INVERTER NAMEPLATE OUTPUT of not more than one thousand two hundred watts TO THE UTILITY ELECTRIC GRID'. Passed both chambers; no delivery to the Governor recorded as at 1 August 2026. Takes effect on the ninetieth day after becoming law.
legislation.effective_rule: ninetieth day after it becomes law
